== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Dantooine, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 12 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of March 1, 2017” (PDF made 31 May 2017): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf source], preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Dantooine (Dark) (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].
